DeWalt DCF787N-SFXJ 18V brushless impact driver delivers fastening performance of 170Nm maximum torque and up to 3200bpm impact rate. The brushless motor reduces the number of wearing parts and generates less heat, extending tool life and runtime compared to brushed alternatives, whilst the aluminium front housing provides excellent heat dispersion. Variable speed control from 0-2800rpm enables precise application across different fastener types and materials, and the drop-in keyless 6.35mm hex holder allows one-handed bit changes. Also features fan-cooled motor, electronic brake, all-metal gearing and LED work light, combined with a soft-grip handle and low weight of 0.9kg. making this impact driver ideal for professional tradespeople.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
